# Director, AI Product Operations

Company: Example AI
Location: Remote
Work arrangement: Remote
Salary range: $175,000 - $220,000

## Job Description

Own AI product strategy and requirements for an AI-enabled workflow product. Design human-in-the-loop review, prompt and context workflows, AI evaluation, responsible AI safeguards, and user acceptance testing. Partner with product, engineering, operations, and domain experts to turn user feedback and failure analysis into reliable product behavior. Machine-learning model training and MLOps are not responsibilities of this role.
